description: This file implements a service class (`GoogleVertexLLMService`) for integrating Google Vertex AI language models into a larger application. It extends from a base `GoogleLLMService`, handles credentials and client setup, and provides configuration options specific to Vertex AI's environment, including deprecated parameter handling and client creation logic.
